proof.prec_resistor_definition: rpm AND (poly overlapping poly.rs) AND psdm
proof.interpretation: Seven catalog obligations have conservative empty-subject proofs only. An entirely absent UHVI region cannot be straddled by any selected geometry. Deep-well enclosure requires the deep-well target itself absent, including explicit mask data. Precision-resistor and RPM-selected subjects require empty RPM, URPM, CRPM and poly-resistor purposes. The nwell-hole angle subject requires no holes in the merged nwell and no explicit nwell mask or extended-drain markers. Candidate cell names or labels prevent the associated proof. Nonempty subjects stay unreviewed; source N/A values are not used as waivers. Nonempty rule meanings and complete device qualification remain separate, including the catalog/manual depmos.8 and urpm.3 naming differences.
discrepancies: The catalog calls the precision-resistor enclosure urpm.3 while the matching manual description is rpm.3. Both implant selectors and poly-resistor data are required empty; no nonempty threshold/name equivalence is claimed.

The catalog depmos.8 selects nwell holes over poly; the manual selects holes overlapping a drain-extended PMOS drain. The complete merged nwell has no holes, and explicit masks/device markers are also absent. This does not resolve their nonempty selector difference.
UHV manual values and rpm.10 are N/A while catalog messages exist. N/A is not used as a waiver; only independently established empty operands discharge these records.
